$comment: The registry of every diagnostic code pkinative reports. The diagnostics-parity rule of scripts/verify-docs.ts keeps it in bidirectional sync with the PkiDiagnosticCode union of src/types/pki-types.ts and requires a payload factory for every code in src/core/pki-diagnostics.ts. The union is additions-only: a code is never renamed or removed. Delivery: strict: true throws PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC; onDiagnostic receives every diagnostic; otherwise console.warn once per code per operation. Parse results also record every diagnostic.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A serial number is longer than 20 octets.
diagnostics.remedy: Accept or refuse by policy; some verifiers refuse such certificates.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A serial number is zero or negative.
diagnostics.remedy: The value is still returned as decoded; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: The outer signatureAlgorithm differs from tbsCertificate.signature.
diagnostics.remedy: Treat the certificate as unverifiable; a verifier must refuse it.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: An RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 algorithm identifier has absent or non-NULL parameters.
diagnostics.remedy: Accept or refuse by policy; RFC 3279 requires NULL parameters.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A certificate carries extensions but declares version 1 or 2.
diagnostics.remedy: The extensions are still decoded; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A certificate carries a unique identifier but declares version 1.
diagnostics.remedy: The identifier is still decoded; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A validity date before 2050 is encoded as a GeneralizedTime.
diagnostics.remedy: The instant is decoded correctly; the issuer violates the RFC 5280 encoding rule.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A GeneralizedTime in a certificate carries fractional seconds.
diagnostics.remedy: The instant is decoded to the millisecond; RFC 5280 forbids fractions in certificates.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: notBefore is later than notAfter.
diagnostics.remedy: The certificate is valid at no instant; refuse it wherever validity matters.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: The issuer name is an empty sequence.
diagnostics.remedy: Chain building by name will not find an issuer; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: The subject is empty and subjectAltName is absent or not critical.
diagnostics.remedy: Read the identity from subjectAltName, and treat the certificate as non-conforming.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A subjectAltName or issuerAltName extension contains no GeneralName.
diagnostics.remedy: The extension carries no identity; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A multi-valued relative distinguished name is not in DER SET OF order.
diagnostics.remedy: Compare names attribute by attribute, never by bytes.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A PrintableString contains an ASCII character outside the PrintableString alphabet, such as '*', '@' or '&'.
diagnostics.remedy: The value is decoded as ASCII; web PKI issuers commonly do this in wildcard names.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A TeletexString is decoded.
diagnostics.remedy: The value is decoded as ISO 8859-1, the interpretation of real-world issuers; read the raw bytes when T.61 semantics matter.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A critical extension has an OID pkinative does not decode.
diagnostics.remedy: A verifier must refuse the certificate unless it processes the extension itself (the raw value is kept).

diagnostics.raisedWhen: basicConstraints sets pathLenConstraint while cA is false.
diagnostics.remedy: Ignore the constraint; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: keyUsage asserts no bit.
diagnostics.remedy: Treat the key as usable for nothing; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: A named bit list, such as keyUsage, keeps trailing zero bits.
diagnostics.remedy: The bits decode identically; the encoder is not DER.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: nameConstraints is not marked critical.
diagnostics.remedy: Enforce the constraints anyway; RFC 5280 requires conforming CAs to mark them critical.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: authorityKeyIdentifier carries only one of authorityCertIssuer and authorityCertSerialNumber.
diagnostics.remedy: Use keyIdentifier for chain building; the pair is unusable alone.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: certificatePolicies lists one policy OID more than once.
diagnostics.remedy: Every occurrence is kept as decoded; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: policyConstraints sets neither requireExplicitPolicy nor inhibitPolicyMapping.
diagnostics.remedy: The extension constrains nothing; the issuer violates RFC 5280.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: encodingRules is 'ber' and the input uses a construct DER forbids (indefinite length, constructed string, non-minimal length, a non-canonical BOOLEAN).
diagnostics.remedy: Expected for BER inputs such as CMS; never re-sign or compare such bytes as if they were DER.

diagnostics.raisedWhen: mode is 'lax' and a block deviates from the strict grammar: whitespace around a boundary line or inside the base64 text, base64 lines that are not 64 characters long, or RFC 1421 headers. Explanatory text outside blocks is ignored in both modes, as RFC 7468 §2 requires.
diagnostics.remedy: Expected for hand-edited or legacy PEM; fix the producer to get strict output.
